feature: Plain-text document templates and immutable draft revisions
status: draft; synthetic-data validation required before release

storage.revision: DocumentVersion.notes: {format: lawyermind-draft-v1, body, operationId}; source EDITOR_TEXT_V1
storage.hash: DocumentVersion.sha256 hashes exact UTF-8 body; not a digital signature
storage.compatibility: Legacy upload notes and storageKey are not interpreted or overwritten; no schema migration
storage.migration_path: Move namespaced envelopes to dedicated content/storage fields in a separately reviewed migration if the pilot grows

authorization.policy: Existing workspace membership and documents.view/documents.edit permissions; documentScope inherits matter and contract confidentiality
authorization.sharing: Templates and drafts are shared with authorized members of the workspace, not private per-user vaults
authorization.account_boundary: A user cannot supply another workspaceId without active membership; author comes from authenticated session

concurrency.create: Client operation UUID maps to deterministic workspace/user-scoped object ID; short scalar Workspace row lock serializes retries; different content with reused key returns 409
concurrency.save: Scalar LegalDocument row lock, expectedVersion comparison, unique (documentId,version), immutable inserts and atomic currentVersion update
concurrency.retry: Exact retry of latest successful save returns that revision without another audit event; an older retry after further edits conflicts without appending
concurrency.review: Status changes require expectedVersion and revalidate current version and signing evidence under the document lock

ui.flow: Documents > save text template > fill fields > open draft > review/edit > save > reopen
ui.recovery: Unsaved editor text is kept in tab memory, partitioned by authenticated user/workspace/document; never browser persistent storage. Link and tab-close prompts protect pending edits.
ui.brand: LawyerMind text name and approved credit; approved PNG symbol remains pending successful Library materialization

remaining: Own email/password authentication with verified email ownership and password reset; Google path remains unchanged

Full authenticated browser E2E and production-readiness review

validation.database: tests/document-draft-db.test.ts; RUN_DB_TESTS=1 on isolated PostgreSQL only
